project.name: Importer — cURL
project.description:
Turns a cURL command into draft scenarios.
The lowest-friction way onto the platform: everyone has a cURL command, usually copied straight out of browser dev tools, and it already contains the method, path, headers and body a test needs.
It also carries credentials, which is why this module strips them and reports their absence rather than importing them. Depends on platform-domain only, and executes nothing: the command is parsed as arguments, never handed to a shell (CLAUDE.md §23).
